objectives: Match the pi-claude-code-ui plugin transcript look: tool rows with no panel background, state dots, folded groups, expandable outputs

Phase 7 (user-approved): full plugin diff block — per-line background tints, deeper tint on changed words, left accent bar, number-then-sign gutters, rules per hunk, hunk labels, summary/footer lines; plus the 'Turn took' line and the vertical branch guide under tool rows
decisions: Change blocks paint surfaces; tool rows stay background-free (revises the Phase 3/5 'no backgrounds' rule). Base = Theme.terminalBackground (OSC 11) mixed toward state colour: add 0.24 / del 0.12 lines; word 0.44 / del 0.26; context surface 0.05 toward text; '▌' accent bar; rules/dividers in borderMuted
Gutter reads number then sign ('12-', '13+'), divider before body; no more '...' separator row between hunks
Word marks are the deeper band (not state foreground); unpaired or dissimilar pairs get one band, no word ranges

DiffViewOptions.hunkLabel: 'Edit i/n at line L' when the call made >1 edit, 'Hunk i/n at line L' when one edit spans hunks, none for a single hunk (its position goes on the summary line '+1 -1 at line 8')
Summary '2 edits +5 -4' above, footer '2 edits +5 -4 · 2 hunks (11 diff lines)' below (only when >1 hunk); shared builders in core/tools/renderers/change-block.ts used by edit + bash-edit renderers
ToolBranchBlock guide: '├' first row, '│' middle, '└' last, blank rows unguided, glyph 2 cols right of the row marker

Turn line '✻ Turn took 6s (Total time 6s · 1 turn)': live = prompt->agent_end; replay = session entry timestamps (prompt -> last entry before next prompt); countedTurnMs/countedTurns reset via renderSessionEntries(..., { turnTotals: 'reset' | 'continue' }), 'continue' only for the compaction-split rebuild; liveTurnStartedAt cleared on rebuild
Title-case row verbs: Read/Edit/Write/Grep/Find/Ls; shell rows keep '$ command'
Shell edit leaving the file unchanged shows 'no change' row instead of '(no output)'
Collapsible diff budget counts diff rows only (24); rules, labels, blanks on top
